title: 第12章 都是为了艺术
content_zh:
《英雄》正在热映，票房的增长，不断刺激着国内的电影行业。

    而这些和励志振兴中国电影的谷川无关，他还在热情的接待着来自日本的投资者。

    “我想拍的是国企下岗潮下小人物的悲痛和无奈……”

    谷川捧着酒杯，一个劲的对投资人灌酒，在酒桌上嘴巴一刻都没有闲过。

    投资人都喝了三杯了，他连杯子的底都没见过，一直在说话。

    和谷川一起吃饭的，叫长宗不二，专门投资国内的文化团体。

    长宗不二听着谷川讲述的内容，对他是越看越喜欢。

    小时候移居美国，一直在美国长大，接受的是西方的教育，对国内的情况很不喜欢，回国之后，要拍国内的阵痛事件。

    这样的人物不投资，那还投资谁？

    何况这人还是南加州大学导演系的，有人脉，有能力，获奖的可能性很大，能造成的影响大。

    长宗不二咽下嘴中五十度的白酒，大着舌头开口道：“谷桑。”

    谷川眉头一皱，不满的说道：“叫我Mr.谷。”

    长宗不二愣了一下，然后改口：“Mr.谷，我非常欣赏你的才华。”

    谷川眯着眼睛说道：“所以，你已经决定要投资我了？”

    “不不不，我还要具体的评估。”长宗不二说道：“你演员要找谁？”

    “男主找一个国内的老艺术家，女主找金锁。”

    “范小胖？”长宗不二说道：“她？她不合适吧？”

    “很合适。”谷川一本正经的说道：“她这么漂亮的人，遭受到各种磨难，会让评委更爽的。”

    “爽？”

    长宗不二怀疑自己喝多听错了。

    “来，再来一杯。”

    谷川看这小鬼子还精神着呢，连忙又给他满上了。

    喝不死他，算是我招待不周。

    “不行了不行了，我真的不能喝了！”长宗不二急忙捂住杯子。

    喝的他嗓子都要烧坏了，真的不能再喝了。

    谷川不是从小在美国长大的吗？怎么会这么熟悉国内的酒桌文化？

    又是一杯白酒下肚，长宗不二意识开始模糊。

    谷川继续说道：“这部电影的幕后团队，我用的是陆穿导演的全班人马，质量肯定是有保证的。”

    陆穿？

    长宗不二对这人也很熟悉。
content_en:
"Hero" is currently in theaters, and its box office growth continues to stimulate the domestic film industry.

    And these have nothing to do with Tanigawa, who inspires the revitalization of Chinese movies. He is still enthusiastically receiving investors from Japan.

    "What I want to photograph is the grief and helplessness of small people amid the wave of layoffs from state-owned enterprises..."

    Tanichuan held the wine glass and kept pouring wine to the investors. His mouth was never idle for a moment on the wine table.

    The investor has had three drinks, and he hasn’t even seen the bottom of the cup, and he keeps talking.

    The person who ate with Tanichuan was named Nagamune Fuji, who specializes in investing in domestic cultural groups.

    Nagazong Fuji listened to what Tanikawa said, and the more he watched, the more he liked him.

    I immigrated to the United States when I was a child and grew up in the United States. I received a Western education and disliked the situation in China. After returning to China, I wanted to film the labor pains in China.

    If such a person doesn’t invest, then who else will invest?

    What's more, this person is from the directing department of the University of Southern California. He has connections and abilities. He has a high possibility of winning awards and can have a great impact.

    Chang Zongfuji swallowed the fifty-percent white wine in his mouth, opened his tongue and said, "Tani-san."

    Tanichuan frowned and said dissatisfied: "Call me Mr. Gu."

    Changzong Fujier was stunned for a moment, then changed his words: "Mr. Gu, I admire your talent very much."

    Tanichuan narrowed his eyes and said, "So, you have decided to invest in me?"

    "No, no, no, I want a specific assessment." Nagamune Fuji said, "Who are you looking for as an actor?"

    "The male protagonist is looking for an old domestic artist, and the female protagonist is looking for Jin Suo."

    "Little Fatty Fan?" Chang Zongfuer said, "Her? Isn't she suitable?"

    "It's very suitable." Tanichuan said seriously: "For someone as beautiful as her to suffer all kinds of hardships, it will make the judges more happy."

    "Feeling good?"

    Changzong Fuji suspected that he had heard wrongly because he was drunk.

    "Here, have another drink."

    Tanichuan saw that the little devil was still energetic, so he quickly filled him up again.

    If I can't drink him to death, it means I didn't entertain him well.

    "No, no, no, I really can't drink anymore!" Changzong Fuji hurriedly covered the cup.

    His throat was burning from drinking, and he really couldn't drink anymore.

    Didn't Tanikawa grow up in the United States? How come you are so familiar with the domestic wine table culture?

    After another glass of white wine, Changzong Fuji's consciousness began to blur.

    Tanigawa continued: "The team behind this film, I am using the entire team of director Lu Chuan, and the quality is definitely guaranteed."

    Lu Chuan?

    Changzong Fuji was also very familiar with this person.
